name: Vertical Showdown
description: A rival with more than twice your capital is building its own supply chain from farm to shelf. You cannot outspend it, so out-manoeuvre it: build a two-tier chain of your own, win the Metropolis television aisle, and keep the company growing for four years.

goals.description: Operate at least one factory — own the conversion step instead of paying world-market prices for every television.
Operate at least one farm — a raw-material source of your own makes the chain two tiers deep.
Put televisions on a shelf — prove the chain reaches the customer.
Sell 30% of the televisions bought in Metropolis (trailing three months) — a chain that does not sell is a cost centre.
Stay in business for 48 months — endurance matters when the rival out-banks you.
